about_the_game:
💀 Wishlist Blightened and survive the corruption when the cycle begins!
game where corruption (blight) is both your weapon and your curse. Wield unstable blight energy, explore fractured realms, and overcome monstrous guardians in a world lost to time and reality.

Core Genre Tags: Metroidvania • 2.5D Action Platformer • Dark Fantasy

🔑 Key Features

  • ⚔️ Blight as a Weapon – Fuel your attacks and abilities with blight, a volatile force that grows stronger and more unstable the deeper you go.

  • 🌀 Reality-Bending Exploration – Traverse ruptures in time where environments shift and mutate as your corruption deepens.

  • 🧬 Unlock the Past – Discover relics, whispers, and corrupted memories scattered across ruins frozen in collapsing timelines.

  • 🧊 Hand-Crafted Realms – Journey through frozen wastelands, fungal tombs, and ancient sanctuaries lost beyond time.

  • 🦴 Monstrous Combat – Face brutal enemies like the Mountain Fist Golem in high-speed, precision-driven battles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD R7
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Blightened is a Metroidvania where corruption fuels your strength. Unleash powerful abilities, survive collapsing realms, and fight your way through a broken world shaped by blight.
